clue.text: Bag supplied by fit patient, for example

parts.note: to suit is to fit or be right for
a doctor's patient is a case

explanation.surface: A sick person supplies a bag to someone who is well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fit patient' reads as a healthy person, but 'fit' is a verb here and the patient is merely an example of a case.
explanation.definitionFit: A suitcase is a kind of bag carried when travelling.

clue.text: Revolutionary American monks' leader accepting European is better

indicators.note: revolutionary suggests turning round, so the letters for American are read backwards
accepting means taking something in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a prior heads a community of monks

explanation.surface: Claims that a radical American abbot who welcomes a European is the better man.
explanation.definitionFit: Superior is a synonym for better, higher in quality.

clue.text: Contribution from Russian leader put to the bottom

indicators.note: in a down entry the bottom is the end, so the opening letters (the word put itself) go to the end

parts.note: Vladimir Putin is the Russian leader

explanation.surface: A donation from the Kremlin's leader gets shoved to the bottom of the pile.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put to the bottom' does double duty: PUT, the first three letters of PUTIN, moves to the end, giving IN + PUT.
explanation.definitionFit: Input is what someone contributes to a project or discussion.

clue.text: Rhythm of dance organised with church

indicators.note: organised means arranged, so the letters of dance are rearranged

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A church dance has been organised, and someone is judging its rhythm.
explanation.definitionFit: Cadence is the rise and fall or beat of sound, a rhythm.

clue.text: Look for and understand source of knowledge

parts.note: 'I see' means I understand

indicators.note: a source is where something begins, so the first letter of knowledge is taken

explanation.surface: Advice to go looking for wisdom and grasp where it comes from.
explanation.definitionFit: To seek is to search for something.

clue.text: Daughter splits and moves off course

parts.note: rifts are splits or cracks

explanation.surface: A daughter breaks away from the family and wanders off course.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat or person that drifts wanders from the intended path.

clue.text: Dish that sees gunners fiddle endlessly

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, the British Army's gunners

indicators.note: without its end, so the last letter of the synonym goes

parts.note: a fiddle is a violin

explanation.surface: A meal during which artillerymen fiddle about without stopping.
explanation.definitionFit: Ravioli is an Italian pasta dish of filled parcels.

clue.text: Penalty — poor United, missing one, made small adjustments

parts.note: a fine is a penalty

indicators.note: poor suggests badly made, so the remaining letters are jumbled
missing means lacking, so a letter is taken out of United

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A football report: a penalty, a weak United side without one player, and the manager tinkering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing one' takes I out of UNITED, leaving UNTED, which 'poor' rearranges to TUNED.
explanation.definitionFit: To fine-tune is to make tiny tweaks for the best result.

clue.text: Draw small boat with sails

parts.note: a ketch is a two-masted sailing boat

explanation.surface: An instruction to draw a little sailing boat.
explanation.definitionFit: To sketch is to draw roughly.

clue.text: Fancy whistle — end of time in short

parts.note: a pipe is a simple whistle-like instrument

indicators.note: in puts one piece inside the other

parts.note: a short is a small measure of spirits, a dram

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A posh whistle blows at full time, briefly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' is not an abbreviation signal but a noun: a short is a small drink of spirits, DRAM, which takes E inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A pipe dream is a fanciful hope, a fancy that will never come true.

clue.text: Headache jet fighter mainly precipitated

parts.note: a MiG is a Russian jet fighter

indicators.note: mainly means most of, so the last letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: rain is precipitation, so precipitated means rained

explanation.surface: A pounding head brought on by jet fighters mostly raining down.
explanation.definitionFit: A migraine is a severe, recurring kind of headache.

clue.text: Approach without a place for meeting

indicators.note: without means lacking, so the letter A is removed

parts.note: an avenue is an approach, as in an avenue of attack or a tree-lined drive

explanation.surface: Someone tries to approach a meeting place, but there is none.
explanation.definitionFit: A venue is a place where an event or meeting is held.

clue.text: Sailor called about trip without regulars

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes round the other

parts.note: rang means telephoned, called

indicators.note: dropping the regularly spaced letters of trip keeps its first and third

explanation.surface: A sailor phoned about a journey, without the regular crew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regulars' here means the letters at regular intervals, not habitual customers.
explanation.definitionFit: A rating is a non-commissioned sailor in the navy.

clue.text: Sceptic may be acting so strangely

indicators.note: strangely means oddly, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A doubter may behave rather oddly.
explanation.definitionFit: An agnostic doubts that anything can be known of God, a religious sceptic.

clue.text: Gets out concealing feature works of art

indicators.note: concealing means hiding inside, so one piece goes inside the other
out means wrong or disordered, so the letters of gets are shuffled

parts.note: the chin is a facial feature

explanation.surface: Someone escapes while hiding a feature of artworks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' is the anagram signal for the first word, not a sense of escaping; the feature is a facial one.
explanation.definitionFit: Etchings are prints made from engraved plates, artworks.

clue.text: Arrangement may see others upset about carbon quota

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the shuffled letters go around the C
upset means overturned or disturbed, so the letters are reordered

parts.note: C is the chemical symbol for carbon
a ration is a fixed quota or share

explanation.surface: A climate deal where others are unhappy about their carbon allowance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' rearranges OTHERS to ORHEST; 'about' puts it around C to make ORCHEST.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchestration is the arranging of music for an orchestra, an arrangement.

clue.text: Opening protected by covers and traps

indicators.note: protected by means surrounded, so the opening sits inside the covers

parts.note: cakes as a verb means coats or covers thickly, as mud cakes boots
a hole is an opening

explanation.surface: A gap shielded by lids and snares, like a trapdoor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'traps' looks like snares but is British slang for mouths.
explanation.definitionFit: Cakeholes and traps are both British slang for mouths.

clue.text: Honestly moving in secret

indicators.note: moving means shifting position, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Truthfully, someone is relocating without telling anyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something on the sly means doing it covertly.

clue.text: Plot of redneck hating changes?

indicators.note: changes means alters, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A storyline about a bigot who hates change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plot' sounds like a story's plot but means a patch of ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen garden is a plot for growing vegetables and herbs for the house.

clue.text: Current needed in burnt out energy generator

indicators.note: needed in means put inside, so the current goes into the shuffled letters
out means disordered, so the letters of burnt are rearranged

parts.note: I is the symbol for electric current
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Electricity is required in a burnt-out power generator.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges BURNT to TURBN, and 'needed in' puts I inside to make TURBIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A turbine is a rotary machine driving a generator of power, loosely a generator.

clue.text: Always seeming younger during language lessons?

indicators.note: during means within, so the letters are found inside the words

explanation.surface: Someone stays youthful through all their language classes.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone ageless never appears to grow old.

clue.text: Sharp American detectives in charge

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, British police detectives

explanation.surface: A shrewd American runs the detective team.
explanation.definitionFit: Acidic means sour or tart in taste, sharp.

clue.text: Clear he is taken in by company charter

indicators.note: taken in means put inside, so he goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: to charter is to hire or rent

explanation.surface: It is plain he has been fooled by the firm's founding document.
explanation.definitionFit: A coherent argument is clear and logical.

clue.text: Like chutney?

definitions.meaning: to enjoy something greatly, a verb
a pickle or condiment, of which chutney is one example

explanation.surface: A question: something resembling chutney?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Like' reads as 'similar to' but is the verb meaning enjoy.
explanation.definitionFit: Relish means enjoy, and a relish is a tangy condiment such as chutney.

clue.text: Secret hostelry supported by Her Majesty

indicators.note: in a down entry, supported means having the other piece below

parts.note: an inn is a hostelry
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

explanation.surface: A clandestine pub with royal patronage.
explanation.definitionFit: Inner means private or hidden, as in inner thoughts.

clue.text: Enclave of near eastern region?

indicators.note: an enclave is a territory surrounded by others, so the letters sit enclosed in the words

explanation.surface: A question about an enclave in a Near Eastern region.
explanation.definitionFit: An area is a region or district.

clue.text: City store entertaining centre of fashion

indicators.note: entertaining means hosting, so the shop holds the letter inside

parts.note: a deli is a delicatessen, a food store

indicators.note: the centre of a word is its middle letter

explanation.surface: A city shop is hosting a fashion event.
explanation.definitionFit: Delhi is a major city in India.

clue.text: Workers will be after material for officers

indicators.note: the workers come after the fabric in the answer

parts.note: serge is a twilled woollen fabric
worker ants are the classic crossword workers

explanation.surface: Factory hands will chase fabric meant for officers' uniforms.
explanation.definitionFit: Sergeants are non-commissioned officers in the army or police.

clue.text: Pamper small group attached to cook, oddly

indicators.note: attached to means the small group is joined onto the letters from cook, which come first
oddly means the odd-numbered letters are taken

parts.note: a set is a group

explanation.surface: A little team is assigned to a chef who behaves strangely, to indulge him.
explanation.definitionFit: To cosset is to spoil or indulge someone.

clue.text: Meet the cost of accommodating second Balkan potential witness

indicators.note: accommodating means housing, so the other pieces go inside

parts.note: to meet the cost of something is to pay for it
a Serb is from Serbia, a Balkan country

explanation.surface: Paying the expenses of a second Balkan national who might testify.
explanation.definitionFit: A passer-by happens to be on the scene, so could witness an incident.
